summary: Iteration 17 — full backend + frontend testing of SMA Negeri 1 Laguboti rebrand/features. All 3 pytest cases green and every requested UI flow verified: public GET /api/settings returns new Laguboti fields (npsn, nss, land_area 3.444 m², accreditation A, principal Panjaitan, mission=13 items, history_periods=14 items, goals/environment/goals_short/medium/long/targets, login_* fields); PATCH /api/settings persists login text + list fields for super_admin and is correctly rejected without auth; Login page shows 'SMA NEGERI 1 LAGUBOTI' branding + school-info card (Berdiri 1966, NPSN 10208460, Akreditasi A, address/phone/email) + working 'Lihat Presentasi' link to /presentasi; Presentation deck has exactly 11 slides including PPDB Online, Tugas & Mini-Quiz and Kartu Pelajar Digital, slide-prev/next and slide-print visible; Informasi Sekolah page as super admin renders Profil, Visi, Misi, Tujuan, Berwawasan Lingkungan, Jangka pendek/menengah/panjang, Sasaran; editing 'about' saves + persists after reload with success toast; Settings page 'D. Teks Halaman Login' section exposes all six login-*-input fields, saving login_headline is reflected on /login immediately. Values were restored to original after each mutation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3100+ lines — consider splitting into routers (auth/settings/academic/ppdb) for maintainability.
After successful login, frontend redirects to '/' instead of '/dashboard' — not a bug (both render dashboard) but inconsistent with the review request wording.
Two background 401 requests observed on first login render (likely /api/me or notifications polling before token set) — harmless but worth guarding.
seed_data_creation: None. Test used TEST_* markers for mission/goals/history_periods/about/login_headline and restored originals after each check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for this iteration is at /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_laguboti_settings.py. The Settings singleton is stored in collection 'settings' with _id='singleton'; DEFAULT_SETTINGS seeds Laguboti data on first boot via get_settings(). Login endpoint returns token in 'access_token' field.
